newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold closes down, silver steady.
newsitem.headline: India gold closes down, silver steady.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed 20 rupees lower at 4,530 rupees per 10 gramme against the previous close of 4,550 rupees amid sluggish demand and a weak trend in the world market.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) closed 200 rupees lower at 53,000 rupees per piece on fresh selling after a steady start.
** Silver (.999) closed steady at 6,700 rupees per kg against the previous close but down 5 rupees against the opening level of 6,705 rupees as light profit-taking trimmed gains towards the close.
